The desk is glad to help midweek
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must check pet details before arrival and follow staff directions at once. Aurelia Skyways asks every traveler to keep papers ready and to listen closely to the welcome team.

For larger dogs, <<FACT F063>>. Bring a secure crate and make sure your pet can rest calmly before boarding. The welfare coordinator will review comfort needs and may stop a trip if a crate looks unsafe or too tight.

For cats, <<FACT F055>>. Small dogs also need the right crate, and <<FACT F068>>. Please keep the animal calm, use plain labels, and report any sign of stress without delay.

Speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance and final checks before travel.
